detector_defect_correction.defect: census_tool.py dispatch-1 MD walk used a 24-token carry window for SHA-claim path context; in sparse prose this spans 10+ lines and bled unrelated package filenames (HANDOFF.md, CORRECTION_NOTES.md, GATES/AMENDMENTS.md, RETRACTIONS.md, ROADMAP_MAPPING.md, UNRESOLVED.md) onto claims that actually refer to .pre files (external) and the V4-layer md/json/manifest values (superseded-historical per the package's own append-only record)
detector_defect_correction.consequence: 7 FALSE-POSITIVE MISMATCH findings at dispatch 1 (files: CORRECTION_NOTES.md, GATES/AMENDMENTS.md, HANDOFF.md, RETRACTIONS.md, ROADMAP_MAPPING.md, UNRESOLVED.md; sources GATE_INDEX.md lines 82/161/165/166/170 + matrix V4.md line 326)
detector_defect_correction.verification: each of the 7 findings inspected line-by-line at source: GATE_INDEX.md line 82 = the completion-run GATE_INDEX.md.pre SHA (external); lines 161/228 = the V4-R2/V4.1-run .pre SHAs (external); lines 165/166/170 = the V4-layer SHAs of the V4 md/json/manifest, superseded in place by the V4.1 edit (the LIVE values at lines 252/254/256 match fresh); matrix V4.md line 326 = the run-mirror pc24_synthetic_measurement.json SHA (external). ZERO real package-file SHA breaks found in the dispatch-1 findings.
detector_defect_correction.fix: claim-locality rule: a hex associates ONLY with path tokens on its own line or the immediately preceding line (census_tool.py walk_md, commented in place). Hex-first matching (a recorded SHA equal to any fresh package hash is a MATCH regardless of context) is unchanged and was never affected by the defect.
detector_defect_correction.re_dispatch: dispatch 2 re-executes the census with the fixed detector; the dispatch-1 raw outputs are preserved in this history record (the census JSONs are overwritten by dispatch 2 as the LIVE census)

detector_defect_correction_2.defect: census_tool.py dispatch-2 MD walk used a FLAT same-line+prev-line candidate SET; the package's multi-artifact EVIDENCE citation lines (matrix V4.md lines 96/144/156: 6-7 external artifacts each with their own SHA plus ONE package filename per line) attributed EVERY hex on the line to the package file
detector_defect_correction_2.consequence: 15 claims mislabeled SUPERSEDED_HISTORICAL vs GATES/AMENDMENT_ITER035_ROWS10_11.json / GATES/AMENDMENT_ITER036_CLOSURE.json at dispatch 2 (they are EXTERNAL references: iter024/iter030/iter032/iter033 artifacts, repair-run offline_rechecks/fail_closed_gates, CONSTANT_ADDRESS_LOCK, pc24_synthetic_measurement). No false MISMATCH (both amendment files have their own matching claims: CBBEEEB9 / 2B1FF548) - a classification-accuracy defect, not a detector false-alarm
detector_defect_correction_2.verification: matrix V4.md lines 96/144/156 read at source: the citation grammar is 'NAME (SHA256 HEX); NAME (SHA256 HEX); ...' - each hex belongs to the NEAREST name-token before it; the true amendment claims CBBEEEB9 (line 96) and 2B1FF548 (lines 144/156) are already MATCHes; the other 15 hexes on those lines cite external artifacts
detector_defect_correction_2.fix: positional association: a hex's primary context = the nearest usable path-like token BEFORE it on the same line; secondary = the previous line's tokens; usable-token rule (letters-only extensions, no numeric fragments) + non-package path-like tokens classified EXTERNAL_REFERENCE (bare-name external artifacts now resolve instead of UNKNOWN)
detector_defect_correction_2.re_dispatch: dispatch 3 re-executes the census with the positional-association detector; dispatch-2 counts preserved in dispatch_history
